name: Speak Now
llm_description: Speak Now is Taylor Swift's third studio album, written entirely by herself without co-writers as a response to skeptics of her songwriting, featuring confessional storytelling and revenge fantasy narratives like Dear John and Mean.
llm_emotion_analysis: Confessional and defiant; passionate regret, vindication, and romantic enchantment told with theatrical, dramatic intensity.
llm_overall_public_reception: Very positive; debuted at number one with over one million first-week sales, and was praised for proving her self-sufficiency as a songwriter.
